correctness.rationale: For every odd integer with exactly two interior zeroes, a three-run binary parametrization is unique. Removing two factors from any even multiplier preserves digit sum. For each odd multiplier 3,5,7,9, the multiplication carry deficit contracts as floor(e/2), hence after four input ones enters a one-output fixed point; therefore the Hamming weight difference is unchanged by reducing runs longer than four to four. This leaves exactly 70 capped triples at length at least seven, all exhaustively verified twice by independent exact arithmetic mechanisms. Every case is assigned its first successful multiplier among these four; no smaller odd or even candidate is possible. In the remaining family, n=3(2^(L-2)-1) has binary weight L-2, and each positive multiple of 2^r-1 has at least r ones, proved by cyclic folding. The closed class counts follow from compositions. The finite certificate is used only after an independently justified infinite-to-finite reduction. No independent audit is claimed.

value.rationale: The source explicitly selects minimum flimsy witness as a central natural invariant. Two zeroes are the first natural family admitting several competing first multipliers rather than trivial cases. The result determines an infinite exact first-witness spectrum and closed cardinality distribution, with a proof reducing infinitely many words to 70 elementary machine-verifiable states. It is more informative than the known yes/no classification and furnishes a reusable carry-saturation technique for small witness sets. It is not an arbitrary fixed-length slice, isolated small gain, or restatement of the known sturdy cases.
